name: Heauton Ekenosen

phase_0.boundary_condition: The divine economy of self-emptying and restoration

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state prior to the incarnation event

TANCH.justification: The final fullness that contains the entire redemptive cycle

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation from divinity into human form

AREV.justification: The return morphism from the finite back to the infinite

CLINK.justification: The composition of divine and human natures in one person

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential subject who performs the act of emptying

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the singular subject into the form of God and the form of a servant

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of the humbled form with the original glory

EVALT.justification: The affirmative alignment of the human will with the divine purpose

EVALF.justification: The negative state of absolute loss and biological death

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous state of the immortal suffering and the dead living

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible record of the completed work

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the Father before the Word is spoken
phase_3.true_description: The glorification of the Son in the light of the resurrection
phase_3.false_description: The descent into Hades and the reality of the tomb
phase_3.both_description: The mystery of the God-Man existing in two natures without confusion

steps.domain_action: The pre-temporal existence of the subject in the Godhead
The subject recognizes its own equality with God
The subject initiates the act of self-distinction for the purpose of emptying
The subject assumes the likeness of men through the incarnation
The divine nature composes with the human nature in a single person
The subject maintains perfect obedience to the divine will
The subject experiences the paradox of the creator existing as a creature
The subject undergoes the negation of life through death on a cross
The historical fact of the death is recorded in the cosmic register
The subject begins the return through the resurrection from the dead
The servant form and the divine form are reconciled in the glorified body
The subject returns to the self-recognition of its original glory
The new title is permanently appended to the subject identity
The cycle completes in the total fullness of the divine economy

phase_6.cycle_cost: The voluntary surrender of the independent exercise of divine attributes
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Infinite actuality in the glorified humanity
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The emptying is exactly compensated by the subsequent filling
